page.overview:
What is Abdul Al-Hazim?

Abdul Al-Hazim is a vampire of Clan Assamite during the Modern Nights and was a member of Christof Romuald's Coterie under the nickname Pink until his deception was revealed. He appears in the video game Vampire: The Masquerade - Redemption.

Abdul was born and Embraced sometime in the early-to-mid 1800s. As a fairly recent Embrace, he met Khadija Al-Kindi in Alexandria, who managed a clandestine trade network moving contraband across the Mediterranean. He fell in love with her, and seeing her on the cusp of old age, determined she should live forever, and Embraced her in 1876. The relationship didn't last much longer than it took for her to grow into her new condition, and once she realized he was chronologically younger than her, she abandoned him.

Some years later in 1999, Abdul was hired by the Tzimisce to prevent Christof from finding Vukodlak before he arose by killing him. However, after encountering him at Club Tenebrae in London, he decided to aid him in killing the local Setites and later the Giovanni in New York whilst under the guise of "Pink" as a Brujah Clan member.
